text:
Jordan (Support): EaveLabs trial blocked — embedding requests returning 403 since 10:04 AM PST. Customer is in onboarding, renewal touch in ~2 weeks. Raising to CS for priority handling :warning:

Alex (CSM): Thanks Jordan. Can you paste the request/response snippet and account id? I'll draft a comms plan.

Jordan (Support): snippet below:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_***' \
  -d '{"input":"..."}'
--> 403 {"error":"quota_exceeded","code":403}
```
Account: eave-67890

Priya (CS Ops): Looking at eave-67890: plan=trial-zero, active_quota=0, last_billing_event=card_declined. Possible provisioning gap.

Sam (AE): FWIW I spoke with their champion yesterday — they're anxious about latency and reliability. This is a high-touch account; renewal is at-risk if onboarding stalls.

Alex (CSM): Proposed comms & playbook (quick):
- Immediate: temp quota bump to unblock onboarding (ops) :phone:
- Near-term: schedule 30m sync with customer + product to capture feedback (CS/AEs) :spiral_calendar:
- Follow-up: run repro, capture logs, assign PM/Eng ticket (CSM)
- Renewal flag: mark customer as "renewal-risk" until post-sync outcome (CS Manager)

Action owners: Priya -> ops bump, Jordan -> customer-facing note + smoke test, Alex -> schedule call & own root-cause ticket, Sam -> prepare renewal impact doc.

Priya (CS Ops): Initiating quota bump request now, ETA ~20m. Creating audit note.

OpsBot: Quota bump requested for eave-67890 by Priya at 1792101240. Status: pending approval.

Jordan (Support): Capturing feedback from initial logs: they hit quota on first batch because their integration defaulted to very large batch_size. Also saw repeated 401/403 before quota change.

Alex (CSM): Draft message I'll send to customer after unblock (feel free to refine):
"Hi <Champion>, we identified a quota provisioning gap that blocked embeddings. We've applied a temporary quota bump so you can continue onboarding. We'll join a quick call tomorrow to review next steps and gather feedback. We're also opening an internal ticket to address root cause and prevent recurrence. Apologies for the disruption."

Sam (AE): I'll join the call and bring an ROI slide to frame the value for upgrading.

Priya (CS Ops): Quota bump completed at 1792101380. Temp quota=50k vectors/day. Billing event shows `card_declined` on initial provision — sending payment recovery ping to billing team now.

Jordan (Support): Verified with customer: embedding requests now succeed end-to-end. They reported latency improved when we reduced batch_size to 16.

Alex (CSM): Great. Next coordination steps:
- Jordan: send calendar invite for 9:00 AM PT tomorrow (30m).
- Priya: follow-up with billing + confirm permanent quota if payment recovers.
- Jordan & Alex: capture feature feedback into product board (embedding dim, batch behavior, SLA ask).

Jordan (Support): Quick feedback notes for PMs: 
- Request: configurable embedding dimension options (smaller dims for lower latency)
- Concern: cold-start latency on first request after idle
- SLA ask: embedding success rate >=99% for trial workloads
- Commercial: interested in reserved/dedicated if latency consistent

Alex (CSM): I'll create the internal ticket and tag PMs + eng with the above notes. Also adding an eval prompt set for regression tests.

Sam (AE): I'll ping the renewal owner with a short update and include next call details.

Jordan (Support): Customer confirmed onboarding can continue. Marking this thread as resolved from support side; keep open for CS follow-up items.

Alex (CSM): Thanks team. I'll post the post-call notes and the comms sent to customer in this thread after the meeting. :thumbsup:
